title: PM Scholarship Scheme (PMSS)
department: Ministry of Defence / MHA & Ministry of Education
description: Financial assistance for meritorious students from low-income families and dependent wards to pursue professional and technical degree courses.
benefits: Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 36,000 per year for tuition and living costs.

rules.description: Must be an enrolled college student

steps.instruction: Register on the National Scholarship Portal.
Upload marksheets and institute verification.
Direct benefit transfer to bank account.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing tuition waiver and maintenance stipend for marginalized students studying Class 11, degree, and postgraduate courses.
benefits: 100% compulsory college fees reimbursed plus monthly maintenance allowance of up to Rs. 13,500/year.

rules.description: Must be studying in post-matric recognized institution
Belong to SC, ST or OBC category
Family annual income not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000

steps.instruction: Register on National Scholarship Portal.
College verifies academic details.
Disbursement via state treasury DBT.

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Financial aid to arrest school dropouts among talented economically disadvantaged students in Class 8.
benefits: Scholarship of Rs. 12,000 per annum (Rs. 1,000 per month) for Classes 9 to 12.

rules.description: Must be an active school student
Age must be 18 years or below
Parents total annual income up to Rs. 3,50,000

steps.instruction: Appear for State NMMSS competitive exam.
Shortlisted merit candidates apply on NSP.
Receive Rs. 12,000 per year.

title: Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
description: Empowers young women pursuing technical diploma and degree programs in engineering and technology across AICTE-approved colleges.
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per annum for tuition fees, purchase of books, equipment, and laptop.

rules.description: Admitted in technical degree or diploma course
Family annual income not exceeding Rs. 8,00,000

steps.instruction: Register online on NSP under AICTE Pragati.
Submit college enrollment details.
Direct scholarship transfer.

title: Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled
description: Scholarship support for differently-abled students admitted to technical diploma and degree courses across AICTE colleges.
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per year towards tuition fees and technical assistive learning aids.

rules.description: Must have benchmark disability of at least 40%
Must be enrolled in technical degree or diploma
Family income ceiling of Rs. 8,00,000 per year

steps.instruction: Apply through National Scholarship Portal.
College Nodal officer verification.
Annual grant credited directly.

title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships (CSSS)
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for top 20th percentile scorers in Class 12 pursuing regular undergraduate/postgraduate degrees.
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per annum for college studies and Rs. 20,000 per annum for postgraduate studies.

rules.description: Must be enrolled in regular college degree program
Gross family income must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000 per annum

steps.instruction: Verify eligibility against board percentile cutoffs.
Register on NSP and submit bank details.
Annual scholarship credit.

title: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
description: Financial scholarship exclusively for meritorious girl students belonging to economically disadvantaged minority communities studying in Classes 9 to 12.
benefits: Rs. 5,000 per year for Classes 9-10 and Rs. 6,000 per year for Classes 11-12.

steps.instruction: Apply online with school bonafide certificate.
Principal verification and state approval.
Direct benefit transfer.

title: National Fellowship for OBC Students (NFOBC)
description: Fellowship grant for OBC candidates pursuing full-time M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees in Sciences and Humanities.
benefits: Stipend of Rs. 31,000/month (JRF) to Rs. 35,000/month (SRF) plus annual contingency grant.

rules.description: Must belong to Other Backward Classes
Enrolled in M.Phil or Ph.D. program
Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 6,00,000

steps.instruction: Apply through UGC NET portal.
Submit university research joining documents.
Monthly fellowship credit via DBT.

title: Puthumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar)
description: Monthly incentive for girl students who studied in government schools (Classes 6 to 12) pursuing higher undergraduate degrees or diplomas.
benefits: Direct monthly assistance of Rs. 1,000 credited to student bank account till degree completion.

rules.description: Enrolled in undergraduate degree or diploma
Resident of Tamil Nadu who attended Govt School

steps.instruction: College Nodal officer registers student on penkalvi.tn.gov.in.
EMIS number verified against school records.
Monthly Rs. 1,000 credited directly.

title: Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored education scheme for Economically Backward Classes (General category) pursuing post-matric courses.
benefits: Reimbursement of tuition fees and monthly maintenance assistance up to Rs. 7,500/year.

rules.description: Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000

steps.instruction: Apply on NSP portal.
College verifies bonafide enrollment.
DBT credit to bank account.

title: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/ST Candidates
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to meritorious SC and ST students to pursue Masters and Ph.D. degrees in prestigious foreign universities abroad.
benefits: Full tuition fees, airfare travel, visa fees, and annual maintenance allowance of USD 15,400 / GBP 9,900.

rules.description: Must belong to Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe
Total family income not exceeding Rs. 8,00,000 per annum
Age below 35 years as on application date

documents.document_name: Unconditional Offer Letter from Top 500 QS World Ranking University

steps.instruction: Register on nosmsje.gov.in portal.
Upload foreign university unconditional offer letter.
Ministry selection committee awards scholarship guarantee letter.

title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
description: Financial support to orphans, children whose parents died due to COVID-19, and children of martyrs to pursue technical education.
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per annum towards college fees, hostel expenses, and books.

rules.description: Enrolled in AICTE recognized technical course

documents.document_name: Death Certificate of Parents / Martyr Certificate

steps.instruction: Apply through National Scholarship Portal.
College Nodal officer verification.
Annual scholarship credit via DBT.

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct annual income support to all landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 directly to bank account.

rules.description: Must be an active landholding farmer

steps.instruction: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or CSC center.
Submit land records and complete Aadhaar e-KYC.
Quarterly Rs. 2,000 credited directly.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance against non-preventable natural risks, drought, floods, and pests.
benefits: Low premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for horticultural crops with full sum insured settlement.

rules.description: Cultivating notified crops in declared areas

steps.instruction: Apply on pmfby.gov.in before cutoff date.
Pay nominal farmer premium online.
Claims settled directly based on satellite and crop-cutting data.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Credit support for farmers to meet short-term cultivation expenses, post-harvest costs, and equipment purchase.
benefits: Revolving credit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at subsidized 4% interest rate (with prompt repayment incentive).

steps.instruction: Download KCC form from bank or pmkisan portal.
Submit to rural bank branch.
Receive RuPay KCC card with pre-approved credit limit.

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
description: Promotes micro-irrigation technologies (Drip and Sprinkler systems) to maximize water use efficiency.
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers for installing drip and sprinkler irrigation.

rules.description: Farmer with cultivable agricultural land and water source

documents.document_name: Water Source & Electricity Bill / Borewell certificate

steps.instruction: Register on State Horticulture / Agriculture portal.
Select approved micro-irrigation vendor.
Field inspection and subsidy credited to beneficiary bank.

title: PM Kusum Scheme (Solar Pumps for Farmers)
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Assists farmers in installing standalone solar agricultural pumps and solarizing grid-connected agriculture pumps.
benefits: 60% government subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) with 30% bank loan; farmer pays only 10% upfront.

rules.description: Farmers having agricultural land and water source for irrigation

steps.instruction: Apply on State Renewable Energy Development Agency (SREDA) portal.
Pay 10% farmer share after site inspection.
Installation of solar pump and net-metering setup.

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY - Organic Farming)
description: Promotes organic farming through cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic conversion, bio-fertilizers, and packaging.

rules.description: Farmers willing to form organic farming clusters of 20 or more ha

steps.instruction: Form a cluster of 50 farmers through local Agricultural Officer.
Register cluster on Jaivik Kheti portal.
Receive organic input subsidies and PGS India certification.

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Farm Equipment)
description: Provides financial subsidy for purchasing modern agricultural machinery like tractors, rotavators, and harvesters.
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on purchase of agricultural equipment, up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers.

steps.instruction: Register on agrimachinery.nic.in portal.
Select equipment model and upload quotation.
Direct subsidy release on purchase verification.

title: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY - Fisheries & Aquaculture)
department: Department of Fisheries (Ministry of Animal Husbandry)
description: Financial assistance to fishers, fish farmers, and coastal communities for setting up modern fisheries infrastructure.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% subsidy for Women/SC/ST for fish ponds, biofloc, cages, and boats.

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age

steps.instruction: Submit project proposal to District Fisheries Officer or online.
District Level Committee (DLC) approval.
Grant subsidy released in milestones.

title: National Livestock Mission (NLM - Poultry, Goat & Dairy Farming)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Promotes entrepreneurship in goat, sheep, poultry, and pig farming with capital subsidies.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 50 Lakh for establishing rural poultry, goat, sheep, and pig breeding farms.

steps.instruction: Apply on nlm.udyamimitra.in portal with DPR.
Bank sanctions loan for remaining project cost.
50% subsidy credited directly to beneficiary loan account.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing providing comprehensive nutrient status report and customized fertilizer recommendations to farmers.
benefits: Free soil testing every 2 years, improving crop yield by 10-15% and saving 8-10% on fertilizer costs.

steps.instruction: Soil sample collected by village extension officer.
Tested in district soil testing laboratory.
Download Soil Health Card online or collect from Panchayat.

title: Kalaignar All Village Integrated Agriculture Development Programme
description: Transforms fallow lands into productive agricultural fields through collective village farming and borewells.
benefits: Free solar power fencing, farm ponds, subsidized oil palm seedlings, and farm tools in select village panchayats.

rules.description: Farmer owning land in Tamil Nadu

steps.instruction: Register with Assistant Director of Agriculture in block.
Site inspection of dryland/fallow parcel.
Benefit allotment under village cluster scheme.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY - Farmer Pension)
department: Ministry of Agriculture / LIC of India
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing old-age social security.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 upon reaching age 60.

rules.description: Small and marginal farmer with cultivable land up to 2 ha

steps.instruction: Visit nearest CSC with Aadhaar and bank details.
Enroll and pay monthly contribution (Rs. 55 to Rs. 200 based on age).
Pension Card issued; monthly Rs. 3,000 from age 60.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Medium to long term debt financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: Interest subvention of 3% per annum up to loan of Rs. 2 Crore for 7 years plus CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage.

steps.instruction: Register on agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal.
Select participating lending institution.
Bank sanctions loan with automatic 3% interest subvention.

title: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
benefits: Better price discovery, online bidding, transparent electronic auction, and direct payment into farmer bank account.

rules.description: Farmer bringing produce to notified APMC mandi

steps.instruction: Register at e-NAM gate entry counter in local mandi.
Produce quality assaying and online auction.
Proceeds transferred directly to bank account via UPI/NEFT.

title: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: Largest health assurance scheme globally providing secondary and tertiary inpatient care for low-income families.
benefits: Cashless health insurance cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for over 1,900 surgical and medical procedures.

rules.description: Annual household income up to Rs. 2,50,000 (SECC criteria)

steps.instruction: Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in with mobile number.
Visit nearest empanelled hospital or CSC.
Generate Ayushman Card for cashless hospitalization.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Senior Citizen Scheme (Age 70+)
description: Universal comprehensive health insurance cover for all senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of family income.
benefits: Distinct Rs. 5,00,000 top-up cashless hospital cover exclusively for individuals aged 70+.

rules.description: Citizen must be aged 70 years or older

steps.instruction: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or Ayushman App.
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC.
Download distinct Ayushman Vaya Vandana card.

title: Pradhan Mantri Bharatiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
description: Provides high-quality generic medicines at significantly discounted prices through dedicated Kendra outlets.
benefits: Quality medicines and surgical items at 50% to 90% cheaper prices than branded market alternatives.

steps.instruction: Locate nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra on the Jan Aushadhi Sugam App.
Show valid doctor prescription.
Purchase medicines at 50-90% discount.

title: Chief Minister Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
department: Health & Family Welfare Department, Tamil Nadu
description: Provides comprehensive cashless hospitalization in Tamil Nadu empanelled public and private hospitals.
benefits: Cashless coverage up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for designated treatments and tertiary surgeries.

rules.description: Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 1,20,000

documents.document_name: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card (Ration Card)
Aadhaar Card of all family members

steps.instruction: Visit the District Collectorate CMCHIS enrolment counter.
Biometric verification with Smart Ration Card.
Smart Health Card issued on the spot.

title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY - Safe Motherhood)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Safe motherhood intervention promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women.
benefits: Cash assistance of Rs. 1,400 in rural areas and Rs. 1,000 in urban areas to the mother post-delivery.

steps.instruction: Register pregnancy at nearest Sub-Center or Anganwadi with ASHA.
Complete at least 3 Ante-Natal Checkups (ANCs).
Institutional delivery in government or accredited private hospital.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Direct benefit transfer maternity benefit providing partial wage compensation for pregnant and lactating mothers.
benefits: Cash incentive of Rs. 5,000 in two installments for 1st child, and Rs. 6,000 for 2nd child if girl child.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of mother and husband

steps.instruction: Register online on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in or at nearest Anganwadi.
Submit MCP card and ANC checkup proof for 1st installment.
Submit child birth registration and vaccination records for final installment.

title: National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (Nikshay Poshan Yojana)
description: Nutritional financial support to all notified tuberculosis patients throughout treatment.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 500 to Rs. 1,000 per month for each month of active anti-TB treatment.

steps.instruction: Diagnosed patient registered on Nikshay portal by doctor/clinic.
Bank details mapped to Nikshay ID.
Monthly nutritional support sent directly via DBT.

title: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN - Rare Diseases & Critical Illness)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Financial assistance to patients living below the poverty line suffering from major life-threatening diseases.
benefits: One-time financial assistance up to Rs. 15 Lakh for specialized medical treatment at super-speciality government hospitals.

rules.description: Must belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) family

documents.document_name: Medical Estimate Report signed by Head of Govt Hospital

steps.instruction: Treating doctor in government hospital prepares treatment cost estimate.
Superintendent forwards application to Ministry of Health.
Funds released directly to the hospital for patient treatment.

title: Mission Indradhanush (Universal Free Immunization)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Free vaccination drive protecting pregnant women and children up to 2 years of age against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases.
benefits: 100% free immunization against Polio, Hepatitis B, Measles, Rubella, Tetanus, Rotavirus, and Pneumonia.

steps.instruction: Visit local primary health center (PHC) or Anganwadi session.
Receive scheduled vaccination dose.
Digital vaccination record updated on U-WIN platform.

title: Mukhyamantri Amrutum (MA) Yojana
description: Tertiary care medical insurance cover for low-income and lower-middle-class families in Gujarat.
benefits: Cashless medical cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for catastrophic illnesses.

rules.description: Annual family income up to Rs. 4,00,000

steps.instruction: Visit Civic Centre or Taluka kiosk.
Submit biometric data and income proof.
Receive MA Vatsalya Smart Card.

title: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
description: State healthcare insurance scheme providing cashless hospital treatments for identified priority families in Maharashtra.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year across 1,000+ empanelled hospitals.

documents.document_name: Yellow, Orange or Antyodaya Ration Card

steps.instruction: Visit Arogyamitra helpdesk at any empanelled hospital in Maharashtra.
Present Ration Card and Aadhaar for online pre-authorization.
Undergo complete cashless medical and surgical treatment.

title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate
description: Small savings scheme exclusively for women and girls offering guaranteed fixed high returns.
benefits: Fixed 7.5% annual interest rate compounded quarterly on deposits up to Rs. 2,00,000 for a 2-year tenure.

steps.instruction: Visit nearest Post Office or public bank.
Fill Account Opening Form 1.
Receive Certificate of Deposit.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Ministry of Finance & Women Child Development
description: Dedicated savings and wealth-creation vehicle for parents of girl children with tax-free high compound interest.
benefits: Guaranteed 8.2% annual compound interest rate, 100% tax exemption under Section 80C, deposit from Rs. 250 to Rs. 1.5 Lakh/year.

rules.description: Account in name of girl child
Age below 10 years at account opening

steps.instruction: Open account at Post Office or commercial bank.
Deposit minimum Rs. 250.
Matures after 21 years or on marriage after age 18.

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Deposit-free clean LPG cooking gas connection for women belonging to poor households.
benefits: Free LPG connection, free first cylinder refill, free hotplate (gas stove), and continuous targeted refill subsidies.

rules.description: BPL or poor household with no existing LPG connection

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of applicant and adult family members

steps.instruction: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or at gas distributor.
Complete biometric e-KYC.
Collect free gas stove and cylinder.

title: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (KMUT)
department: Special Programme Implementation Department, Tamil Nadu
description: Universal monthly basic income grant recognizing women’s unpaid household labour and economic agency in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 1,000 per month deposited directly into woman head-of-household bank account.

rules.description: Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000

steps.instruction: Fill application token at local ration shop camp.
Biometric e-KYC verification.
Monthly Rs. 1,000 credited on the 15th of every month.

title: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
department: Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh
description: Monthly direct financial transfer supporting women health, nutrition, and financial independence in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 1,250 per month into beneficiary bank account.

rules.description: Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000

steps.instruction: Submit form at Gram Panchayat or Ward camp.
Live photograph and Samagra Aadhaar verification.
Monthly assistance credited on 10th of every month.

title: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Financial assistance scheme for economically weaker women in Maharashtra to foster self-reliance.
benefits: Direct cash deposit of Rs. 1,500 per month into beneficiary Aadhaar-linked bank account.

rules.description: Family annual income up to Rs. 2,50,000

steps.instruction: Register via Nari Shakti Doot App or Anganwadi center.
Upload documents and verify Aadhaar.
Direct benefit deposit into bank account.

title: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
department: Women and Child Development Department, Karnataka
description: Financial entitlement scheme providing monthly allowance to woman head of family in Karnataka.
benefits: Rs. 2,000 per month directly transferred to bank account of female head of house.

rules.description: Recognized woman head on ration card

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of woman and husband

steps.instruction: Apply through Seva Sindhu portal or Karnataka-One center.
Ration card verification.
Monthly direct benefit transfer of Rs. 2,000.

title: Mahila Samridhi Yojana (Micro Loans for Backward Women)
department: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation
description: Micro-finance credit scheme for women entrepreneurs belonging to Backward Classes.
benefits: Micro-loan up to Rs. 1,40,000 at subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum for small business ventures.

rules.description: Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000

steps.instruction: Apply through State Channelising Agency (SCA) or SHG.
Project activity appraisal.
Loan sanction with 4% interest rate.

title: Lakhpati Didi Scheme (NRLM)
description: Enables women self-help group (SHG) members to earn a sustainable income of at least Rs. 1,00,000 per annum.
benefits: Skill training in drone piloting, tailoring, LED assembly, digital financial inclusion, and access to interest-subvention loans.

steps.instruction: Enroll through Village Organization or Gram Panchayat NRLM nodal.
Undergo livelihood enterprise training.
Access community investment fund (CIF) and bank credit linkage.

title: Indira Gandhi Matritva Sahyog Yojana (IGMSY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme for pregnant and lactating women to improve health and nutrition.
benefits: Cash incentive of Rs. 6,000 in stages linked to maternal and child healthcare milestones.

steps.instruction: Register at local Anganwadi Center.
Fulfill health checkups and immunizations.
Receive milestone payments via DBT.

title: Subhadra Yojana
department: Women and Child Development Department, Odisha
description: Flagship financial empowerment scheme providing cash vouchers to women in Odisha.
benefits: Financial voucher assistance of Rs. 10,000 per year (in two installments of Rs. 5,000) for 5 years (Total Rs. 50,000).

steps.instruction: Submit application at Mo Seva Kendra or Anganwadi.
Aadhaar e-KYC and single beneficiary bank validation.
Payment on Raksha Bandhan and International Women Day.

title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
department: Women and Child Development, Uttar Pradesh
description: Conditional cash transfer for girl children in Uttar Pradesh across six developmental milestones from birth to graduation.
benefits: Total financial assistance of Rs. 25,000 in six installments supporting education and health.

rules.description: Annual family income not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000

steps.instruction: Register online on mksy.up.gov.in.
Apply for milestone stage (Birth, Vaccination, Class 1, 6, 9, or College).
Direct bank credit.

title: STEP Scheme (Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Provides skill training in traditional and modern sectors (agriculture, food processing, IT, handicrafts, tourism).
benefits: Free certified skill training, daily stipend, and micro-business placement or bank loan linkage.

steps.instruction: Apply at designated training partner institute.
Complete 300-500 hours hands-on training module.
Receive certification and enterprise support.

title: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Safe and affordable furnished residential accommodation for employed women in urban, semi-urban, and rural areas.
benefits: Subsidized secure accommodation with daycare facility for children for working women earning up to Rs. 50,000/month.

steps.instruction: Apply online to nearest Sakhi Niwas / Working Women Hostel.
Submit employer certificate and salary document.
Allotment of secure residential room.

title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services (Ministry of Finance)
description: Collateral-free micro loans for non-corporate, non-farm small enterprises in manufacturing, trading, and services.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh (Shishu: up to Rs. 50k, Kishore: Rs. 50k - 5 Lakh, Tarun: Rs. 5 Lakh - 10 Lakh) with affordable interest.

steps.instruction: Apply via udyamimitra.in or bank branch.
Submit project proposal and quotation.
Mudra card issued for working capital.

title: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit facility for urban and semi-urban street vendors to resume livelihoods and scale businesses.
benefits: Initial working capital loan of Rs. 10,000, progressing to Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and digital cashbacks.

rules.description: Urban street vendor or small hawker

documents.document_name: Certificate of Vending / ULB Letter of Recommendation

steps.instruction: Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in.
Aadhaar OTP authentication.
Direct disbursement within 7 days.

title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Comprehensive support for traditional artisans and craftsmen across 18 artisan trades (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Tailors, Potters, Sculptors).
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate, free skill training with Rs. 500/day stipend, Rs. 15,000 toolkit voucher, and collateral-free loans up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest.

steps.instruction: Biometric registration at CSC.
Panchayat / ULB trade verification.
Complete skill training and receive toolkit voucher.

title: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore covering up to 85% of total project cost in manufacturing, services, or trading.

steps.instruction: Register on standupmitra.in.
Submit business project report.
Bank sanctions loan with credit guarantee support.

title: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked capital subsidy for establishing new micro-enterprises in non-farm manufacturing and service sectors.
benefits: Government subsidy of 25% (Urban) to 35% (Rural/Special Category) on projects up to Rs. 50 Lakh (mfg) and Rs. 20 Lakh (services).

rules.description: Minimum 8th pass for larger project sizes

steps.instruction: Apply online on PMEGP portal.
DLTFC scrutiny committee interview.
Bank sanctions loan with subsidy lock-in.

title: National Career Service (NCS) Portal
description: National digital platform connecting job seekers with certified employers, vacancies, internships, and skill training.
benefits: Free job matching, skill development referrals, free career counselling, DigiLocker integration, and interview alerts.

steps.instruction: Register on ncs.gov.in as Jobseeker.
Create verified profile.
Apply directly to matched job listings.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Flagship skill certification scheme offering free industry-relevant technical and digital training to Indian youth.
benefits: Free industry-aligned training, government certificate, soft skills development, and placement assistance.

steps.instruction: Find nearest PMKVY Training Center (PMKK).
Enroll in course (IoT, AI, Solar, Automotive, Healthcare, etc.).
Pass third-party assessment and receive Skill Certificate.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Promotes apprenticeship training by incentivizing employers and offering stipends to young apprentices.
benefits: Government pays 25% of prescribed stipend up to Rs. 1,500 per month directly to apprentice bank account during training.

steps.instruction: Register on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Apply to open apprentice contracts with companies.
Monthly stipend credited directly.

title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: Provides credit guarantee cover to banks enabling collateral-free loans for micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans up to Rs. 5 Crore with government guarantee cover up to 85%.

steps.instruction: Approach scheduled commercial bank for credit facility.
Bank appraises business proposal.
Bank avails CGTMSE guarantee without demanding collateral.

title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Reduces poverty and vulnerability of urban poor households through self-help groups, skills, and micro-enterprises.
benefits: Interest subvention on micro-enterprise loans over 7% interest rate, and up to Rs. 2 Lakh individual project support.

steps.instruction: Contact City Mission Management Unit (CMMU) in Municipal Corporation.
Form urban SHG or apply for self-employment credit.
Access subsidized loan and skill training.

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households willing to do manual work.
benefits: Statutory minimum daily wage (Rs. 240 to Rs. 370 depending on state) credited directly into worker bank/post office account.

steps.instruction: Submit oral or written request for Job Card to Gram Panchayat.
Gram Panchayat issues NREGA Job Card within 15 days.
Demand work; employment guaranteed within 15 days or unemployment allowance.

title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
description: Financial assistance to innovative early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, and market-entry.
benefits: Up to Rs. 20 Lakh as grant for prototype development, and up to Rs. 50 Lakh through convertible debentures/debt.

rules.description: Startup founder age 18 years or above

steps.instruction: Register startup on startupindia.gov.in to get DPIIT recognition.
Apply for Seed Fund through chosen sector incubator.
Incubator evaluation and milestone grant release.

title: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)
description: Incentivizes employers to generate new employment by government paying employer full EPFO contribution.
benefits: Government pays full 12% employer contribution towards EPF and EPS for 3 years for new employees earning up to Rs. 15,000/month.

steps.instruction: Employer registers new employee on EPFO portal with UAN.
Aadhaar verified employee roster submitted.
Government reimburses employer 12% share directly.

title: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Tamil Nadu
description: Assists educated unemployed youth in Tamil Nadu to establish manufacturing, service, and business enterprises.
benefits: 25% government subsidy up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh on project costs up to Rs. 15 Lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 5 Lakh for service/business.

steps.instruction: Apply on msmeonline.tn.gov.in.
Interview before District Task Force Committee.
Bank loan disbursement with 25% subsidy.

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar Yojana
description: Financial support to educated unemployed youth in UP to set up small industries and service businesses.
benefits: 25% margin money subsidy (up to Rs. 6.25 Lakh for industries, Rs. 2.5 Lakh for service units) on project loans up to Rs. 25 Lakh.

steps.instruction: Submit online application on UP MSME portal.
District Committee screening and bank sanction.
Subsidy converted to grant after 2 years successful operation.

title: ASPIRE Scheme (Agri-Business & Rural Incubation)
description: Sets up a network of technology and livelihood business incubators to promote rural innovation and entrepreneurship.
benefits: 100% one-time grant of up to Rs. 1 Crore for machinery and equipment to set up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI).

steps.instruction: Submit incubation proposal on aspire.msme.gov.in.
Project Appraisal Committee (PAC) review.
Grant release for establishing rural training incubator.

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Non-contributory monthly social pension for destitute senior citizens belonging to below-poverty-line (BPL) households.
benefits: Monthly pension assistance of Rs. 200 - Rs. 500 (with state government top-up up to Rs. 1,000 - Rs. 2,000 in many states).

steps.instruction: Obtain NSAP form from local Gram Panchayat or Municipal Ward.
Attach age proof, BPL card copy and bank passbook.
Monthly pension credited via DBT.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Government-backed guaranteed monthly pension scheme for workers in the unorganized sector.
benefits: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000, or Rs. 5,000 from age 60 onwards.

documents.document_name: Active Bank Savings Account with auto-debit

steps.instruction: Visit bank branch or net banking.
Select chosen monthly pension amount.
Auto-debit starts (from as low as Rs. 42/month).

title: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / ALIMCO
description: Provides physical aids and assisted-living devices for senior citizens belonging to BPL category suffering from age-related disabilities.
benefits: 100% free distribution of assisted-living devices including hearing aids, wheelchairs, walking sticks, spectacles, and dentures.

documents.document_name: Medical Officer Certificate of age infirmity

steps.instruction: Register during District Assessment Camps organized by ALIMCO.
Medical assessment by government doctors.
Free distribution of assistive devices.

title: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
description: Safe and high-yielding government savings scheme exclusively for individuals aged 60 and above offering quarterly interest payouts.
benefits: Guaranteed 8.2% annual interest paid every quarter on deposits up to Rs. 30 Lakh with Section 80C tax deduction.

steps.instruction: Visit Post Office or any public/private bank.
Submit Form A with deposit cheque.
Receive quarterly interest credited directly to savings account.

title: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
department: Ministry of Finance / LIC of India
description: Pension scheme operated by LIC providing assured pension return for 10 years to senior citizens.
benefits: Guaranteed 7.4% per annum monthly pension payout for 10 years with return of full purchase price on maturity.

steps.instruction: Purchase online on licindia.in or visit LIC branch.
Choose monthly, quarterly, or annual pension payout.
Regular pension credited via NEFT.

title: National Pension System (NPS - Tier 1)
description: Government voluntary pension fund offering market-linked market returns, low fund management charges, and tax benefits.
benefits: Pension wealth accumulation with additional Rs. 50,000 tax deduction under Section 80CCD(1B) and lifetime annuity.

steps.instruction: Open PRAN account online via eNPS with Aadhaar OTP.
Choose Pension Fund Manager and asset allocation (Equity/Debt).
Contribute online and claim tax deductions.

title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Monthly social security pension for widowed women living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension assistance of Rs. 300 to Rs. 1,000 (augmented by state top-ups) credited via DBT.

steps.instruction: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Taluk office.
Enclose death certificate and BPL verification.
Monthly direct benefit credit.

title: Tamil Nadu Old Age Pension Scheme (OAP)
description: State social security pension for destitute senior citizens who have no family source of income.
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 credited directly to beneficiary bank account plus free monthly rice allotment.

steps.instruction: Apply at nearest e-Sevai centre in Tamil Nadu.
Revenue Inspector (RI) and VAO field inquiry.
Tahsildar sanctions monthly Rs. 1,000 pension.

title: Vayoshrestha Samman Scheme
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: National honours and welfare awards conferring institutional grants to voluntary organizations running elder homes.
benefits: Free quality healthcare, nutrition, shelter, and medical emergency transport in senior daycare centers.

steps.instruction: Register with District Social Welfare Officer.
Access subsidized day-care and emergency helpline 14567.

title: Elder Line 14567 (National Helpline for Senior Citizens)
description: Toll-free national helpline offering free legal assistance, rescue of abandoned elders, and emotional counseling.
benefits: Free counseling, rescue from abuse, old age home placement, and pension grievance resolution.

steps.instruction: Dial toll-free number 14567 from any phone.
State field response team dispatched for emergency assistance or legal mediation.

title: National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Monthly disability social security pension for citizens with severe or multiple benchmark disabilities.
benefits: Monthly financial pension assistance of Rs. 300 to Rs. 1,500 depending on state, credited via DBT.

rules.description: Must have certified disability of 80% or multiple disability

steps.instruction: Obtain UDID card from Government Hospital.
Submit application to District Social Welfare Officer.
Monthly pension credited directly.

title: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card Scheme
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Creates a national unified electronic database and single verifiable disability identity card across India.
benefits: Seamless national access to all central & state disability concessions, railway/bus travel concessions, and jobs.

rules.description: Certified benchmark disability of at least 40%

documents.document_name: Medical Disability Assessment Certificate from Govt Medical Board

steps.instruction: Register online on swavlambancard.gov.in.
Attend medical assessment date at District Hospital.
Download digital UDID card and receive smart card by post.

title: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids)
description: Provides modern, durable, and scientifically manufactured assistive devices and prosthetics free of cost.
benefits: 100% free distribution of motorized tricycles, smart canes, digital hearing aids, wheelchairs, and calipers.

rules.description: Monthly family income not exceeding Rs. 20,000 (100% grant)

steps.instruction: Register at district ADIP camp or ALIMCO portal.
Custom measurement and fitting test.
Free device handed over with warranty and maintenance support.

title: Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana (Concessional Loans)
department: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation
description: Provides concessional loan finance for persons with disabilities for starting small business enterprises.
benefits: Concessional interest rate loans up to Rs. 50 Lakh (starting from 5% to 8% interest per annum).

rules.description: Must have recognized disability of 40% or more

steps.instruction: Apply through State Channelising Agency or Public Sector Bank.
Submit project proposal for small enterprise.
Loan sanction with subsidized interest rate.

title: National Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Educational financial scholarship for students with disabilities from Class 9 up to post-graduation/Ph.D.
benefits: Maintenance allowance, book grant, and disability equipment allowance up to Rs. 4,000 per month.

rules.description: Family annual income not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000

steps.instruction: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal.
College Nodal officer verification.
DBT credit to bank account.

title: Tamil Nadu Maintenance Allowance for Severely Disabled
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department, Tamil Nadu
description: Special state monthly maintenance allowance for persons with intellectual disability, muscular dystrophy, and severe impairment.
benefits: Monthly direct financial support of Rs. 2,000 credited to bank account.

documents.document_name: National Disability ID Card (UDID) / TN ID Book

steps.instruction: Submit application at District Differently Abled Welfare Office (DDAWO).
Medical board verification.
Monthly Rs. 2,000 credited via DBT.

title: Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan)
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Universal accessibility mission retrofitting public buildings, transport systems, and digital ecosystems.
benefits: Provides retrofitted accessible public infrastructure, braille signage, ramps, accessible websites, and sign language interpreters.

steps.instruction: Download Sugamya Bharat App.
Report inaccessible public buildings with photo.
Authorities mandated to construct ramps/lifts within designated timeframe.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides pucca houses and interest subsidies to all eligible families in urban areas.
benefits: Interest subsidy of up to Rs. 1.80 Lakh on home loans for EWS/LIG families, plus construction assistance up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh.

rules.description: Annual household income up to Rs. 6,00,000 (EWS/LIG)

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Affidavit confirming no pucca house owned in India

steps.instruction: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or via bank home loan.
Urban Local Body verification.
Subsidy credited directly into home loan account.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Direct financial grant to rural homeless and kutcha-house dwelling families to construct a durable pucca house with toilet and electricity.
benefits: Direct cash grant of Rs. 1,20,000 (in plains) and Rs. 1,30,000 (in hilly/NE states) plus 90-95 days of MGNREGA unskilled labour wages.

rules.description: SECC deprivation list / BPL rural household

steps.instruction: Beneficiary identified via Gram Sabha priority list (Awaas+).
Geo-tagged photographic verification of existing site.
Installments credited directly at plinth, lintel, and roof stages.

title: Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHCs)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides dignified, affordable rental housing close to workplaces for urban migrants and industrial workers.
benefits: Low-cost rental apartments with clean drinking water, electricity, and sanitation at nominal monthly rent.

steps.instruction: Apply through local Urban Local Body or industrial concessionaire.
Submit employment proof.
Allotment of rental dormitory or flat.

title: Kalaignar Dream Home Scheme (Kalaignarin Kanavu Illam)
description: State initiative to construct durable concrete houses replacing huts across rural Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Total grant assistance of Rs. 3,50,000 per house directly credited in stages for construction.

rules.description: Rural families living in thatched huts

steps.instruction: Village survey conducted by Block Development Officer (BDO).
Administrative sanction issued for hut demolition & reconstruction.
Direct bank payments upon geo-tagged milestone completion.

title: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group (CLSS MIG)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / HUDCO & NHB
description: Interest subsidy for middle-income citizens availing housing loans for purchase or construction of house.
benefits: Up to 4% interest subsidy upfront reducing total housing loan EMI burden by over Rs. 2.2 Lakh.

rules.description: Annual household income between Rs. 6 Lakh and Rs. 12 Lakh

documents.document_name: Approved Building Plan / Agreement for Sale

steps.instruction: Apply for home loan through participating primary lending bank.
Bank submits claim on Central CLAP portal.
Lump-sum interest subsidy credited into loan principal.

title: Deendayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (Saubhagya - Free Electricity)
description: Universal household electrification providing free electricity service connections to poor households.
benefits: Free electricity service connection with meter, LED bulbs, and wiring for un-electrified rural and urban poor houses.

rules.description: Poor or rural household with no electricity connection

steps.instruction: Apply during rural electrification camp organized by local DISCOM.
DISCOM officials survey home wiring.
Free meter and power connection energized.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
department: Department of Financial Services (Ministry of Finance)
description: National mission for comprehensive financial inclusion ensuring universal access to banking facilities.
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, free RuPay debit card with inbuilt Rs. 2 Lakh accidental insurance cover, and Rs. 10,000 overdraft facility.

steps.instruction: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra kiosk.
Complete simplified KYC with Aadhaar biometric.
Receive zero-balance passbook and RuPay debit card on the spot.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Department of Financial Services (Ministry of Finance)
description: Life insurance scheme offering high coverage at a nominal annual premium for bank account holders.
benefits: Rs. 2,00,000 life insurance cover payable to nominee on death of the insured due to any reason for an annual premium of just Rs. 436.

documents.document_name: Bank Savings Account with auto-debit consent

steps.instruction: Opt-in through net banking, mobile banking, or bank branch.
Authorize annual auto-debit of Rs. 436 in May every year.
Digital insurance policy certificate issued.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
department: Department of Financial Services (Ministry of Finance)
description: Accident insurance scheme providing substantial accidental death and disability coverage for a nominal premium.
benefits: Rs. 2,00,000 accidental death/permanent total disability cover (Rs. 1 Lakh for partial disability) for just Rs. 20 per year.

steps.instruction: Submit one-page consent form at bank branch or via mobile banking.
Automatic annual deduction of Rs. 20.
Instant cover activated.

title: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY - Free Food Grains)
description: Provides free food grains to 80+ crore priority household and Antyodaya beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act.
benefits: 5 kg of food grains (rice/wheat) per person per month completely free of cost, plus 35 kg per family for Antyodaya households.

rules.description: Eligible for Priority Household / AAY ration

steps.instruction: Visit nearest Fair Price Shop (Ration Shop) anywhere in India under One Nation One Ration Card.
Biometric e-POS authentication using Aadhaar.
Collect free monthly quota of rice or wheat.

title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Provides substantial financial subsidies to households installing rooftop solar panels to get up to 300 units of free power.
benefits: Direct Central subsidy of Rs. 30,000 for 1 kW, Rs. 60,000 for 2 kW, and up to Rs. 78,000 for 3 kW solar installations plus collateral-free bank loans at 7%.

documents.document_name: Proof of Roof Ownership / Property Tax Receipt

steps.instruction: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with electricity consumer number.
Choose registered local solar vendor.
DISCOM installs net meter; subsidy credited to bank account in 30 days.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM - Gig & Informal Worker Pension)
description: Old age pension scheme for unorganized workers like rickshaw pullers, domestic maids, street vendors, and gig workers.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 from age 60 onwards with 50% spouse family pension continuity.

documents.document_name: Savings Bank Account Passbook / Jan Dhan Account

steps.instruction: Visit nearest CSC with Aadhaar and bank details.
Pay initial contribution (Rs. 55 to Rs. 200 based on entry age).
Receive PM-SYM Card with unique pension ID.

title: e-Shram Card (National Database of Unorganized Workers)
description: National centralized registry of unorganized workers connecting them to government social security and welfare benefits.
benefits: Universal Account Number (UAN) card, accidental insurance of Rs. 2 Lakh on accidental death/disability, and priority access to disaster relief.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card with linked mobile number

steps.instruction: Self-register on eshram.gov.in or visit CSC.
Declare occupation, skill type, and bank details.
Download 12-digit UAN e-Shram card immediately.

title: Deendayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Placement-linked skill training programme for poor rural youth with guaranteed job placement.
benefits: Free residential market-relevant skill training, uniform, books, tablet, and guaranteed minimum 70% job placement.

documents.document_name: BPL Card / MGNREGA Job Card of parent

steps.instruction: Enroll through Gram Panchayat Kaushalya register or Project Implementing Agency (PIA).
Undergo 3 to 12 months certified residential training.
Get placed in formal corporate or industrial jobs.

title: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC)
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Concessional credit and economic rehabilitation for sanitation workers, waste pickers, and their dependents.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 15 Lakh for mechanized sanitation equipment (suction machines, jetting vehicles) at 4% to 6% interest with capital subsidies.

documents.document_name: Target Group Certificate from Municipality / Local Body

steps.instruction: Apply through State Channelizing Agency (SCA).
Choose mechanized cleaning machinery model.
Sanction of subsidized loan and upfront capital subsidy.

title: PM PVTG Development Mission (Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups)
description: Holistic mission saturating PVTG households with pucca housing, piped drinking water, electricity, and livelihood.
benefits: Complete household saturation package including free pucca house, road connectivity, solar power, and livelihood grants.

rules.description: Must belong to recognized Scheduled Tribe (PVTG)

steps.instruction: District Tribal Development Officer identifies PVTG habitations.
Door-to-door entitlement saturation delivery.
Allotment of housing and community benefits.

title: National Social Assistance Programme (National Family Benefit Scheme - NFBS)
description: Lump-sum financial assistance to bereaved BPL family upon demise of primary breadwinner.
benefits: One-time lump-sum grant of Rs. 20,000 paid immediately to the surviving family member upon death of family breadwinner.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of surviving spouse / head

steps.instruction: Submit application to Block Development Officer / Tahsildar within 6 months of death.
Local revenue inquiry to verify breadwinner status.
One-time Rs. 20,000 credited to bank account.
